register.title: Create an account
register.dobHint: Students must be 18 or over to hold their own account. A younger student is added by a parent.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Length matters more than symbols.
register.parentNoteTitle: Add your child's details after you register
register.parentNoteBody: Children under 18 do not get their own login on Ustaad.com. You register, then add your child's details as a record you own and manage. All contact with a tutor goes through you.
register.studentNoteTitle: This is for students aged 18 or over
register.studentNoteBody: If you are under 18, a parent registers and adds your details to their account. That is why we ask for your date of birth.

error.invalidCredentials: That email address and password do not match an account.
error.emailTaken: An account already exists for that email address.

session.expiring: You will be signed out shortly.

forgot.title: Forgotten your password?
forgot.notBuiltTitle: Password reset is not available yet
forgot.notBuiltBody: We have not built it, and we would rather say so than show you a form that quietly does nothing. A reset needs an email channel we can trust to deliver, and we do not have one yet.
forgot.whatToDoBody: Contact the Ustaad.com team through the "Report a problem" link at the bottom of any page. Include the email address on your account and we will restore access.
